plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 9 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.4024, -122.23863, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.9 km on W0933 Spur 1, Pipeline Rd Salvage by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 70 m W, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2012 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
R5D-deer-atv-0004.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 5-2: about 32,437 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.31 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
12 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
14 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.
Coulthard Rd right here: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 12 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Soda Creek Townsite Rd, Williams Lake Cut-Off Rd, Buckskin Rd, Grouse Rd.
Park: 52.36057, -122.42901, pull off on Coulthard Rd (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Coulthard Rd stretch, 3.9 km one way. About 77 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-14, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
